verdict.rationale: A government tax service with a public developer API platform could reasonably publish llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, so this axis applies. The evidence shows none. The developer hub's robots.txt disallows every crawler except Googlebot, which works against agent access to the API documentation. The 'agent' wording in the sign-up guidance means human tax agents acting for clients, not AI agents, so it earns no credit.
